items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clive Davis, I think, was moved in to be president.

ctx.x: I will sell that story. There was a world meeting of – Columbia representatives from every part of the world were meeting in New York. They request who they’d like to hear of their artists. It’s usually someone that they’ve done business with for years and is doing well. That’s who would entertain at their gathering. So Goddard Lieberson, then president of Columbia, called me and said, “Could you come in and play for the Columbia meeting.” I said, “I’m no longer – I’ve been dropped from your company.” See, he’d…
A conglomerate of industries. But Clive Davis was the head of the record.
